name: SikaSwell S-2
paste:
SIKASWELL® S-2: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: SikaSwell® S-2, April 2023, Version 05.01 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/m/sikaswell-s-2.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide SikaSwell® S-2 where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 05.01).
1.2 Product description. SikaSwell® S-2 is a 1-part polyurethane hydrophilic sealant which swells in contact with water to seal all types of construction joints and penetrations in concrete.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer - Joint sealing.
    - Construction joints
    - Pipe and steel work penetrations through walls and floor slabs
    - Around all types of penetrations and construction joints
    - Construction joints in cable ducts, etc.
1.4 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer - Fixing / Adhering swellable profiles.
    - SikaSwell® A Profiles
    - SikaSwell® P Profiles
1.5 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.7.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. SikaSwell® S-2
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: Polyurethane hydrophilic swellable sealant
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals / certificates.
    - Water Pressure Resistance and Durability tests, SikaSwell® S-2, BBA, Test certificate No.13/4994
    - Water Tightness SikaSwell® S-2, Vattenfall, Test report No. 1278-10
    - Sealing test Building Rules List A, SikaSwell® S-2, WISSBAU, Test report No. 2017-313
2.3 Standards and test methods cited in the data sheet. Cited as written in the data sheet. A citation is not a statement that the product complies with it; conformity is stated only where the data sheet says so (see the approvals clause and the statements quoted in the other clauses).
    - ISO 2811: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Product Information > Density (p.1).
    - ISO 7619-1: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Shore A hardness (p.2).
    - ISO 1817: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Change of volume (p.2).
    - ISO 7390: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Application Information > Sag flow (p.2).
    - CQP 049-2: Sika internal procedure reference, not a published standard. Where: Application Information > Curing rate (p.2).
    - EN 15651: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Application Information > Skinning time (p.2).
2.4 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - 1-part, easy and fast to apply
    - Highly economical joint sealing solution compared to other systems
    - Versatile solution for joints and details
    - Optimised expansion rate, no damage to fresh concrete
    - Permanently water resistant (wet & dry cycles)
    - Good adhesion to various substrates
2.5 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Composition: 1-part polyurethane, moisture curing
    - Appearance and colour: Oxide red
    - Density: 1,24 kg/l (at +23 °C) (ISO 2811)
2.6 Shore A hardness.
    | Non-swollen (7 days / | 30–50 |
    | +23 °C / 50 % r.h.) |
    (Table as printed; a cell that wraps appears over several rows.)
    Test method printed: (ISO 7619-1)
2.7 Change of volume.
    | 1 day in tap water | < 25 % |
    | 7 days in tap water | < 100 % |
    | Swelling properties in salty water will be reduced and delayed. |
    (Table as printed; a cell that wraps appears over several rows.)
    Test method printed: (ISO 1817)
2.8 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Shelf life: 9 months from the date of production
    - Storage conditions: The product must be stored in original, unopened and undamaged sealed packaging in dry conditions at temperatures between +5 °C and +25°C. Always refer to packaging.
2.9 Packaging.
    | 300 ml cartridges | 12 cartridges / box |
    | 600 ml unipacs | 20 unipacs / box |
    | Refer to current price list for packaging variations |
    (Table as printed; a cell that wraps appears over several rows.)

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 General. Prepare substrates in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 05.01) and the requirements below. Inspect the substrate against these requirements before application.
3.2 Substrate quality. The substrate must be sound, clean, dry or matt damp and free from all surface contaminants that could affect adhesion of the sealant.
3.3 Substrate preparation - Existing Concrete.
    - All loose particles, release agents, laitance, paint, rust and other poorly adhering materials must be removed by hand or mechanical preparation.
    - Freshly cast concrete
    - Surfaces which are excessively rough can be susceptible to leaking. It is recommended to smoothen the freshly cast concrete with a batten where the sealant is to be placed.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 05.01) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application data.
    - Sag flow: < 2 mm (+23 °C / 50 % r.h.) (ISO 7390)
    - Skinning time: 60 minutes (+23 °C / 50 % r.h.); Place SikaSwell® profiles onto SikaSwell® S-2 within a maximum of 30 minutes. (EN 15651)
4.3 Consumption.
    | Size of triangular sec- | 300 ml cartridges | 600 ml unipacs |
    | tion |
    | 12 mm | 4,1 m | 8,2 m |
    | 15 mm | 3,1 m | 6,2 m |
    | 20 mm | 1,8 m | 3,6 m |
    (Table as printed; a cell that wraps appears over several rows.)
    Consumption depends on the roughness and absorbency of the substrate. These figures are theoretical and do not allow for any additional material due to surface porosity, surface profile, variations in level or wastage etc.
4.4 Curing rate.
    | 1 day (+23 °C / 50 % r.h.) | ~2,0 mm |
    | 10 days (+23 °C / 50 % r.h.) | ~10,0 mm |
    Test method printed: (CQP 049-2)
4.5 Application method / tools. SikaSwell® S-2 sealant with a SikaSwell® profile; Apply SikaSwell® S-2 in a narrow bed (size of triangular section ~12 mm) onto the prepared substrate. Extrude sufficient quantity to level the roughness of the substrate. Press the SikaSwell® A and P profiles firmly into the fresh applied SikaSwell® S-2. The profiles must be placed within a maximum of 30 minutes. Allow SikaSwell® S-2 to harden minimum 24 hours before placing concrete. Before placing concrete, protect the SikaSwell® profiles against water (e.g. rain). SikaSwell® S-2 sealant without a SikaSwell® profile Apply SikaSwell® S-2 in a triangle bead onto the prepared substrate. Use a triangular nozzle or cut the nozzle to obtain a regular triangular extrusion section and apply SikaSwell® S-2 according to the following table. Allow SikaSwell® S-2 to harden for 1–2 days before placing concrete.
    | Structure thickness | Size of triangular section |
    | < 20 cm | 12 mm |
    | 20–30 cm | 15 mm |
    | 30–50 cm Place SikaSwell® S-2 in the centre of the concrete structure, minimum cover 8 cm (reinforced concrete) or 15 cm (unreinforced concrete). Before placing concrete, protect the SikaSwell® S-2 against water (e.g. rain). | 20 mm |
4.6 Cleaning of equipment. Clean all tools and application equipment immediately after use with Sika® Colma-Cleaner. Hardened material can only be removed mechanically.
4.7 Limitations and important considerations.
    - Do not use SikaSwell® S-2 for movement joints.
    - SikaSwell® S-2 must be placed in the centre of the concrete structure.
    - Minimum cover to sealant on both sides must be 8 cm (reinforced concrete) or 15 cm (unreinforced concrete).
    - Ensure a full and continuous contact between the SikaSwell® S-2 profiles and the substrate.
    - For pouring height > 50 cm, SikaSwell® S-2 must harden for at least 3 days.
    - Protect SikaSwell® S-2 from any water (e.g. rain, process and ponding water) before casting the concrete.
    - SikaSwell® S-2 expands if it becomes in contact with water. This is not instantaneous and may take a few hours.
    - In a totally dry state, SikaSwell® S-2 shrinks to its original dimensions then expands again in contact with water.
    - SikaSwell® S-2 is recommended for sealing against water pressures up to 2 bar. For pressures higher than 2 bar, SikaSwell® S-2 can be used as a supplementary joint sealing solution.
    - During concreting, compact well around the SikaSwell® S-2 to provide a dense concrete without any honeycombing or voids.

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, measure and record the conditions in clause 5.2 and compare them with the manufacturer's limits. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Substrate moisture content. Dry or matt damp
5.3 Ambient air temperature. +5 °C min. / +35 °C max.
5.4 Substrate temperature. +5 °C min. / +35 °C max.
5.5 Conditions stated in the limitations. Also stated in the data sheet limitations (clause 4.7):
    - Protect SikaSwell® S-2 from any water (e.g. rain, process and ponding water) before casting the concrete.
5.6 Test methods printed beside stated values. Each value is as printed in the data sheet with its test method.
    - Density: 1,24 kg/l (at +23 °C) (ISO 2811)
    - Shore A hardness: Non-swollen (7 days / | 30–50; +23 °C / 50 % r.h.) (ISO 7619-1)
    - Change of volume: 1 day in tap water | < 25 %; 7 days in tap water | < 100 %; Swelling properties in salty water will be reduced and delayed. (ISO 1817)
    - Sag flow: < 2 mm (+23 °C / 50 % r.h.) (ISO 7390)
    - Curing rate: 1 day (+23 °C / 50 % r.h.) | ~2,0 mm; 10 days (+23 °C / 50 % r.h.) | ~10,0 mm (CQP 049-2)
    - Skinning time: 60 minutes (+23 °C / 50 % r.h.); Place SikaSwell® profiles onto SikaSwell® S-2 within a maximum of 30 minutes. (EN 15651)
5.7 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.8 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: SikaSwell® S-2, April 2023, Version 05.01, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/m/sikaswell-s-2.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS SikaSwell® S-2, version 05/02/2026, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/e/sds-sikaswell-s-2.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. For information and advice on the safe handling, storage and disposal of chemical products, users shall refer to the most recent Safety Data Sheet (SDS) containing physical, ecological, toxicological and other safety-related data.
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.2, and include the records in the project documentation.
